examples.chinese: 你喜歡什麼顏色？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuān shénme yánsè?
examples.english: What color do you like?

examples.chinese: 這件衣服的顏色很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: The color of this clothing is very pretty.

examples.chinese: 這件衣服的顏色很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: The color of this clothing is very pretty.

examples.chinese: 這件衣服的顏色很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu de yánsè hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: The color of this clothing is very pretty.

examples.chinese: 五十塊錢很便宜！妳看，哪個顏色漂亮？
examples.pinyin: Wǔshí kuài qián hěn piányí! Nǐ kàn, nǎ ge yánsè piàoliang?
examples.english: It is inexpensive! Look, which color is better?

examples.chinese: 我不太喜歡這條裙子的顏色。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xǐhuān zhè tiáo qúnzi de yánsè.
examples.english: I don't really like the color of this skirt.

examples.chinese: 白色是今年很流行的顏色。
examples.pinyin: Báisè shì jīnnián hěn liúxíng de yánsè.
examples.english: White is a very popular color this year.

examples.chinese: 陳小姐今天穿了一件跟我相同牌子的洋裝，還好顏色不同。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiǎojiě jīntiān chuān le yī jiàn gēn wǒ xiāngtóng páizi de yángzhuāng, hái hǎo yánsè bùtóng.
examples.english: Miss Chen wore a dress of the same brand as mine today; fortunately, the color is different.

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 小何穿著綠色牛仔褲、紅襯衫，再戴上藍色的帽子，我覺得這些顏色配在一起很醜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hé chuānzhe lǜsè niúzǎikù, hóng chènshān, zài dài shàng lánsè de màozi, wǒ juéde zhèxiē yánsè pèi zài yīqǐ hěn chǒu.
examples.english: Xiǎo Hé is wearing green jeans, a red shirt, and then puts on a blue hat; I think these colors paired together are very ugly.

examples.chinese: 我今天跟同學穿了樣式不同，但是顏色相同的洋裝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān gēn tóngxué chuān le yàngshì bùtóng, dànshì yánsè xiāngtóng de yángzhuāng.
examples.english: Today my classmate and I wore dresses that are different in style but the same in color.

examples.chinese: 上課時他把筆記寫在本子上，也把重點寫在不同顏色的便條(紙)上。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí tā bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, yě bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài bùtóng yánsè de biàntiáo (zhǐ) shàng.
examples.english: During class he wrote the notes in his notebook, and also wrote the key points on sticky notes of different colors.

examples.chinese: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 很好看。這條藍的也很漂亮，藍色是今年很流行的顏色。
examples.pinyin: Hěn hǎokàn. Zhè tiáo lán de yě hěn piàoliang, lánsè shì jīnnián hěn liúxíng de yánsè.
examples.english: It is. This pair of blue pants is beautiful too. Blue is a popular color of this year.

examples.chinese: 他今天很開心。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: He is very happy today.

examples.chinese: 今天我去朋友家玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ qù péngyǒu jiā wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: I had fun at my friend’s place today.

examples.chinese: 他唱歌唱得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Tā chànggē chàng de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: He enjoys singing very much.

examples.chinese: 我昨天跟朋友說了很多話，我們都很開心。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān gēn péngyou shuō le hěn duō huà, wǒmen dōu hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Yesterday I said a lot to my friend, and we were both very happy.

examples.chinese: 你們在聊什麼？聊得好開心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zài liáo shénme? Liáo de hǎo kāixīn.
examples.english: What are you chatting about? You're chatting so happily.

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，每個週末我都有很多活動，覺得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, měi ge zhōumò wǒ dōu yǒu hěn duō huódòng, juéde hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have many activities every weekend and feel very happy.

examples.chinese: 這是我第一次來台灣，我覺得好開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái Táiwān, wǒ juéde hǎo kāixīn.
examples.english: This is my first time coming to Taiwan, I feel very happy.

examples.chinese: 他的表演很有意思，我們大家看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Tā de biǎoyǎn hěn yǒu yìsi, wǒmen dàjiā kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: His performance is very interesting, we all watched it very happily.

examples.chinese: 這張照片裡的人都笑得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn lǐ de rén dōu xiào de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: The people in this photo are all smiling very happily.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？看起來很不開心的樣子。 B:唉！工廠發生問題，今天又得加班處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Kàn qǐlái hěn bù kāixīn de yàngzi. B: Āi! Gōngchǎng fāshēng wèntí, jīntiān yòu děi jiābān chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: What's wrong? You look very unhappy. B: Alas! There's a problem at the factory; I have to work overtime again today to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 我昨天晚上做了一個夢，夢到跟我最喜歡的明星一同演戲，開心得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le yī gè mèng, mèng dào gēn wǒ zuì xǐhuan de míngxīng yītóng yǎnxì, kāixīn de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last night I had a dream; I dreamed of acting together with my favorite celebrity, and I was incredibly happy.

examples.chinese: 週末我帶孩子們去鄉下玩，他們餵小羊吃草，拿饅頭給猴子吃，玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dài háizimen qù xiāngxià wán, tāmen wèi xiǎoyáng chī cǎo, ná mántou gěi hóuzi chī, wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: On the weekend, I took the children to the countryside to play; they fed the lambs grass and gave steamed buns to the monkeys to eat, and they had a great time.

examples.chinese: 我是金東賢的戲迷，今天終於看到他本人，實在太開心了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Jīn Dōngxián de xìmí, jīntiān zhōngyú kàndào tā běnrén, shízài tài kāixīn le.
examples.english: I am a fan of Kim Dong-hyun; today I finally saw him in person, and I am really so happy.

examples.chinese: 每當包太太心情不好的時候，包先生就會說笑話來逗她，讓她開心一點。
examples.pinyin: Měidāng Bāo tàitai xīnqíng bù hǎo de shíhou, Bāo xiānsheng jiù huì shuō xiàohua lái dòu tā, ràng tā kāixīn yìdiǎn.
examples.english: Whenever Mrs. Bao is in a bad mood, Mr. Bao will tell jokes to tease her and make her a little happier.

examples.chinese: 儘管爺爺去世很久了，但每次看到照片，就會回想起他開心陪我玩的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yéye qùshì hěn jiǔ le, dàn měi cì kàn dào zhàopiàn, jiù huì huíxiǎng qǐ tā kāixīn péi wǒ wán de yàngzi.
examples.english: Even though Grandpa passed away a long time ago, every time I see a photo, I recall how he happily played with me.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 我身體不舒服，所以不能跟你們去打球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēntǐ bù shūfu, suǒyǐ bù néng gēn nǐmen qù dǎ qiú.
examples.english: I am not feeling well, so I cannot go play ball with you.

examples.chinese: 我感冒了，頭很痛，眼睛、耳朵也不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, tóu hěn tòng, yǎnjing, ěrduo yě bù shūfu.
examples.english: I caught a cold; my head hurts a lot, and my eyes and ears are also uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 你覺得哪裡不舒服？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ juéde nǎlǐ bù shūfu?
examples.english: Where are you uncomfortable? (What brings you here today?)

examples.chinese: 我咳嗽、頭痛，鼻子也不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ késou, tóu tòng, bízi yě bù shūfu.
examples.english: I have a cough and headache. Also my nose is uncomfortable.

items.wordHook: 不(not) + 舒(relaxed) + 服(clothes) → not relaxed in your clothes, so you feel sick.

examples.chinese: 這是我第一次來台灣，我覺得好開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì lái Táiwān, wǒ juéde hǎo kāixīn.
examples.english: This is my first time coming to Taiwan, I feel very happy.

examples.chinese: 上次我們吃牛肉麵，這次也吃牛肉麵，下次吃別的吧。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì wǒmen chī niúròumiàn, zhè cì yě chī niúròumiàn, xià cì chī bié de ba.
examples.english: Last time we ate beef noodles, this time we're also eating beef noodles; next time let's eat something else.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友這次去英國玩了八天七夜。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyou zhè cì qù Yīngguó wán le bā tiān qī yè.
examples.english: This time I went to England with a friend and played for eight days and seven nights.

examples.chinese: 這次去荷蘭旅行的費用很高，因為車票很貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qù Hélán lǚxíng de fèiyòng hěn gāo, yīnwèi chēpiào hěn guì.
examples.english: The cost of this trip to the Netherlands is very high because the train tickets are very expensive.

examples.chinese: 老師很滿意大家這次期中考的成績。這次期中考，大家都考得很好，老師覺得很滿意。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī hěn mǎnyì dàjiā zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo de chéngjī. Zhè cì qīzhōngkǎo, dàjiā dōu kǎo de hěn hǎo, lǎoshī juéde hěn mǎnyì.
examples.english: The teacher is very satisfied with everyone's midterm exam results. On this midterm exam, everyone did very well, and the teacher feels very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 這次的旅行很順利，沒有什麼問題。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lǚxíng hěn shùnlì, méiyǒu shénme wèntí.
examples.english: This trip was very smooth; there were no problems.

examples.chinese: 山本良介來台灣以後，搬了兩次家。
examples.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè lái Táiwān yǐhòu, bān le liǎng cì jiā.
examples.english: After Yamamoto Ryosuke came to Taiwan, he moved house twice.

examples.chinese: 暑假出國旅遊的人很多。這次的旅遊真有意思，我以後還想多去幾個地方玩。
examples.pinyin: Shǔjià chūguó lǚyóu de rén hěn duō. Zhè cì de lǚyóu zhēn yǒu yìsi, wǒ yǐhòu hái xiǎng duō qù jǐ gè dìfang wán.
examples.english: Many people travel abroad during summer vacation. This trip is really interesting; in the future I want to go to more places to have fun.

examples.chinese: 第一次約會的時候，林先生感覺(到)自己很緊張。這棟公寓除了環境不錯，家具還很新，感覺住起來會很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Dì yī cì yuēhuì de shíhou, Lín xiānsheng gǎnjué (dào) zìjǐ hěn jǐnzhāng. Zhè dòng gōngyù chúle huánjìng búcuò, jiājù hái hěn xīn, gǎnjué zhù qǐlái huì hěn shūfu.
examples.english: On their first date, Mr. Lin felt that he was very nervous. Besides having a nice environment, this apartment building also has very new furniture; it feels like it would be very comfortable to live in.

examples.chinese: 這個字你寫錯了，請再寫一次。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zì nǐ xiě cuò le, qǐng zài xiě yí cì.
examples.english: You wrote this character wrong; please write it again.

examples.chinese: 這次考試的分數沒有我想的那麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de fēnshù méiyǒu wǒ xiǎng de nàme chà.
examples.english: The score on this exam is not as bad as I thought.

examples.chinese: 這次考試很難，可是大家的分數都不低，好奇怪！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì hěn nán, kěshì dàjiā de fēnshù dōu bù dī, hǎo qíguài!
examples.english: This exam was very hard, but everyone's scores are not low—how strange!

examples.chinese: 這是我第一次搭飛機，所以覺得很興奮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì dā fēijī, suǒyǐ juéde hěn xīngfèn.
examples.english: This is my first time taking an airplane, so I feel very excited.

examples.chinese: 到東部的火車票很難訂，我訂了好幾次才成功。這次社區的中秋節活動辦得很成功，大家都玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Dào dōngbù de huǒchēpiào hěn nán dìng, wǒ dìng le hǎojǐ cì cái chénggōng. Zhè cì shèqū de zhōngqiūjié huódòng bàn de hěn chénggōng, dàjiā dōu wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Tickets for trains to the east are hard to book; I tried several times before succeeding. This time the community's Mid-Autumn Festival event was very successful, and everyone had a great time.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾張當地的明信片，這些是這次旅行很好的紀念。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ zhāng dāngdì de míngxìnpiàn, zhèxiē shì zhè cì lǚxíng hěn hǎo de jìniàn.
examples.english: I bought several local postcards; these are a very good souvenir of this trip.

examples.chinese: 我的汽車每半年就需要保養一次。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qìchē měi bàn nián jiù xūyào bǎoyǎng yī cì.
examples.english: My car needs maintenance once every half year.

examples.chinese: 我上次口試的時候太緊張，所以沒聽懂老師問的問題。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shàng cì kǒushì de shíhòu tài jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ méi tīngdǒng lǎoshī wèn de wèntí.
examples.english: Last time during the oral test, I was too nervous, so I didn't understand the questions the teacher asked.

examples.chinese: 這次期末的筆試不太難，大家都考得不錯。今天早上考筆試的時候，我寫得太慢了，所以沒寫完。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò de bǐshì bù tài nán, dàjiā dōu kǎo de bùcuò. Jīntiān zǎoshang kǎo bǐshì de shíhou, wǒ xiě de tài màn le, suǒyǐ méi xiě wán.
examples.english: This final written exam is not too hard; everyone did pretty well. This morning when I took the written exam, I wrote too slowly, so I didn't finish.

examples.chinese: 我每次翻譯日文小說的時候，都要查字典。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì fānyì Rìwén xiǎoshuō de shíhou, dōu yào chá zìdiǎn.
examples.english: Every time I translate Japanese novels, I need to look up words in the dictionary.

examples.chinese: 這次數學期末考的筆試很難，我有四題寫錯了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué qīmòkǎo de bǐshì hěn nán, wǒ yǒu sì tí xiě cuò le.
examples.english: This math final written exam was very hard; I got four questions wrong.

examples.chinese: 我吃了不乾淨的東西，今天就拉了三次肚子了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chīle bù gānjìng de dōngxi, jīntiān jiù lāle sān cì dùzi le.
examples.english: I ate something unclean, and today I have already had diarrhea three times.

examples.chinese: 爸爸這幾天背很疼，看了兩次病了，還是不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Bàba zhè jǐ tiān bèi hěn téng, kànle liǎng cì bìng le, háishì bù shūfu.
examples.english: Dad's back has been hurting these few days; he has seen the doctor twice, but he is still uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 每次出國時，機場的安全人員都會檢查我們的護照和行李。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì chūguó shí, jīchǎng de ānquán rényuán dōu huì jiǎnchá wǒmen de hùzhào hé xíngli.
examples.english: Every time we go abroad, the airport security staff check our passports and luggage.

examples.chinese: 為了做這個報告，經理已經跟我們開過三次會了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zuò zhège bàogào, jīnglǐ yǐjīng gēn wǒmen kāi guò sān cì huì le.
examples.english: In order to prepare this report, the manager has already had meetings with us three times.

examples.chinese: 他這次到美國去出差，幫公司處理了不少問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè cì dào Měiguó qù chūchāi, bāng gōngsī chǔlǐ le bù shǎo wèntí.
examples.english: He went on a business trip to the US this time and handled quite a few problems for the company.

examples.chinese: 我這次考試的成績不太好，下次我會更加努力的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhè cì kǎoshì de chéngjì bú tài hǎo, xià cì wǒ huì gèngjiā nǔlì de.
examples.english: My grades on this exam are not very good; next time I will work even more hard.

examples.chinese: 老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現， 明年要請他當經理呢！這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào qǐng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english: Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 聽說小張離過三次婚，你想他還會再結婚嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō Xiǎo Zhāng lí guò sān cì hūn, nǐ xiǎng tā hái huì zài jiéhūn ma?
examples.english: I heard Xiao Zhang has been divorced three times; do you think he will get married again?

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 爺爺去過阿里山好幾回，每次去都看到不同的風景，他說非常值得。
examples.pinyin: Yéye qù guò Ālǐshān hǎo jǐ huí, měi cì qù dōu kàn dào bùtóng de fēngjǐng, tā shuō fēicháng zhídé.
examples.english: Grandpa has been to Alishan several times; every time he goes, he sees different scenery, and he says it's very worthwhile.

examples.chinese: 剩下的飯菜加熱太多次，就沒什麼營養了，最好每餐都吃光。
examples.pinyin: Shèngxià de fàncài jiārè tài duō cì, jiù méi shénme yíngyǎng le, zuìhǎo měi cān dōu chī guāng.
examples.english: If leftover food is heated too many times, it loses its nutrition; it's best to finish it all at each meal.

examples.chinese: 經理這次願意採用新員工的建議，讓我們都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhè cì yuànyì cǎiyòng xīn yuángōng de jiànyì, ràng wǒmen dōu xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: The manager is willing to adopt the new employee's suggestion this time, which gave us all a start.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 陳老師為了引起學生的學習興趣，每次上課前都會準備一些有趣的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Chén lǎoshī wèile yǐnqǐ xuéshēng de xuéxí xìngqù, měi cì shàngkè qián dōu huì zhǔnbèi yīxiē yǒuqù de yóuxì.
examples.english: In order to arouse the students' interest in learning, Teacher Chen prepares some interesting games before every class.

examples.chinese: 這次強烈地震造成了嚴重的災情，不但許多房屋塌了，連橋也斷了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qiángliè dìzhèn zàochéng le yánzhòng de zāiqíng, búdàn xǔduō fángwū tā le, lián qiáo yě duàn le.
examples.english: This strong earthquake caused severe damage due to the disaster; not only did many houses collapse, but even bridges broke.

examples.chinese: 這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān. 2. Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english: 1. This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting. 2. The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 這次社區的中秋節活動，決定在戶外舉辦，萬一下雨了就搬到室內去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shèqū de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, juédìng zài hùwài jǔbàn, wànyī xià yǔ le jiù bān dào shìnèi qù.
examples.english: This community Mid-Autumn Festival event has been decided to be held outdoors; if it rains, it will be moved indoors.

examples.chinese: 朋子看了好幾次醫生，吃了好幾個星期的藥，病總算好了。
examples.pinyin: Péngzǐ kàn le hǎo jǐ cì yīshēng, chī le hǎo jǐ gè xīngqī de yào, bìng zǒngsuàn hǎo le.
examples.english: Pengzi saw the doctor several times and took medicine for several weeks, and her illness finally got better.

examples.chinese: 記者說參加這次慢跑活動的人數已經超過了一百人，可是我數來數去只有五十幾個。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shuō cānjiā zhè cì mànpǎo huódòng de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguò le yìbǎi rén, kěshì wǒ shǔ lái shǔ qù zhǐyǒu wǔshí jǐ ge.
examples.english: The reporter said the number of people participating in this jogging event has already exceeded one hundred, but I counted and counted and there were only fifty-some.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 上次出國時，到了機場才發現沒帶護照，這次我絕對不會再忘了。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì chūguó shí, dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn méi dài hùzhào, zhè cì wǒ juéduì bù huì zài wàng le.
examples.english: Last time I went abroad, I only discovered at the airport that I hadn't brought my passport; this time I absolutely will not forget again.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 參加這次總統選舉的人實力都不錯，最後是陳先生當選了。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā zhè cì zǒngtǒng xuǎnjǔ de rén shílì dōu bùcuò, zuìhòu shì Chén xiānsheng dāngxuǎn le.
examples.english: The people who participated in this presidential election all had good qualifications; in the end, Mr. Chen was elected.

examples.chinese: 我到德國留學的頭兩個星期，因為對環境不環境而迷過幾次路，後來就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào Déguó liúxué de tóu liǎng gè xīngqī, yīnwèi duì huánjìng bù shúxī ér mí guò jǐ cì lù, hòulái jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: In the first two weeks of studying in Germany, because I was not familiar with the environment, I got lost a few times; later there was no problem.

examples.chinese: 五年前經驗過護照被偷的意外後，每次出國我都把護照放在上衣裡面的口袋。
examples.pinyin: Wǔ nián qián jīngyàn guò hùzhào bèi tōu de yìwài hòu, měi cì chūguó wǒ dōu bǎ hùzhào fàng zài shàngyī lǐmiàn de kǒudài.
examples.english: After experiencing the accident of having my passport stolen five years ago, every time I go abroad, I put my passport in the pocket inside my jacket.

examples.chinese: 還好你告訴我今天黃教授的課停課一次，要不然我就白跑一趟了。
examples.pinyin: Háihǎo nǐ gàosu wǒ jīntiān Huáng jiàoshòu de kè tíngkè yī cì, yàobùrán wǒ jiù bái pǎo yī tàng le.
examples.english: Good thing you told me that Professor Huang's class is canceled today; otherwise, I would have made a trip in vain.

examples.chinese: 小戴第一次跟女朋友的父母見面時，緊張得不得了，說話、吃飯都很不自在。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài dì yī cì gēn nǚpéngyǒu de fùmǔ jiànmiàn shí, jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo, shuōhuà, chīfàn dōu hěn bù zìzài.
examples.english: When Xiǎo Dài met his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he was extremely nervous, and he was very uncomfortable both talking and eating.

examples.chinese: 張先生滑雪的技巧很好，這次比賽他有信心能夠得到前三名。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng huáxuě de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, zhè cì bǐsài tā yǒu xìnxīn nénggòu dédào qián sān míng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang's skiing skills are very good; for this competition, he has confidence that he can get into the top three.

examples.chinese: 這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, lián zǒngtǒng yīshí yě hěn nán zhǎngwò gèdì de zāiqíng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake was very large; even the president had difficulty grasping the disaster situation in various places for a while.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 小李第一次參加釣魚比賽就得了第一名，真是幸運。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ dì-yī cì cānjiā diàoyú bǐsài jiù dé le dì-yī míng, zhēn shì xìngyùn.
examples.english: Little Li got first place the first time he participated in a fishing competition; he is really lucky.

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò kǎo de tímù hěn nán, dàjiā de chéngjì dōu bù hǎo, hái yǒu jǐ ge rén bèi dāng le.
examples.english: The questions on this final exam were very difficult; everyone’s grades were bad, and several people even failed the course.

examples.chinese: 老師說這次口試的題目不難，回答是只要放輕鬆、別緊張，就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhè cì kǒushì de tímù bù nán, huídá shì zhǐyào fàng qīngsōng, bié jǐnzhāng, jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: The teacher said the questions on this oral exam are not hard; the answer is that as long as you relax and don't be nervous, there's no problem.

examples.chinese: 這次數學考試的題目似乎難了點，因為超過三分之二的學生考不及格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué kǎoshì de tímù sìhū nán le diǎn, yīnwèi chāoguò sān fēn zhī èr de xuéshēng kǎo bù jígé.
examples.english: The questions on this math exam seem a bit difficult, because more than two-thirds of the students failed.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 他透過網路認識了一位網友，直到結婚前，他們才見過對方三次。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò wǎnglù rènshi le yī wèi wǎngyǒu, zhídào jiéhūn qián, tāmen cái jiàn guò duìfāng sān cì.
examples.english: He met an online friend through the Internet, and they had only seen each other three times before they got married.

examples.chinese: 小李好幾次約女網友見面，都被拒絕，所以不再跟她聯絡了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ hǎojǐ cì yuē nǚ wǎngyǒu jiànmiàn, dōu bèi jùjué, suǒyǐ bù zài gēn tā liánluò le.
examples.english: Xiao Li asked his female online friend to meet several times but was rejected each time, so he no longer contacts her.

examples.chinese: 你知道第一次世界運動會是在哪裡舉行的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào dì yī cì shìjiè yùndònghuì shì zài nǎlǐ jǔxíng de ma?
examples.english: Do you know where the first World Games were held?

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，第一次辦理護照得本人親自去，不能請別人代替嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, dì-yī cì bànlǐ hùzhào děi běnrén qīnzì qù, bùnéng qǐng biérén dàitì ma?
examples.english: In your country, the first time you apply for a passport, do you have to go in person yourself, and cannot ask someone else to do it for you?

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: 史小姐做事很細心，這張表我檢查過好幾次，還是被她發現了幾個錯字。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ xiǎojiě zuòshì hěn xìxīn, zhè zhāng biǎo wǒ jiǎnchá guo hǎojǐ cì, háishi bèi tā fāxiàn le jǐ ge cuòzì.
examples.english: Ms. Shi is very careful in her work; I checked this form several times, but she still found a few typos.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 儘管爺爺去世很久了，但每次看到照片，就會回想起他開心陪我玩的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yéye qùshì hěn jiǔ le, dàn měi cì kàn dào zhàopiàn, jiù huì huíxiǎng qǐ tā kāixīn péi wǒ wán de yàngzi.
examples.english: Even though Grandpa passed away a long time ago, every time I see a photo, I recall how he happily played with me.

examples.chinese: 不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng. / Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.
examples.english: I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction. / The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 那個外國人第一次來臺灣就碰上了大地震，讓他非常難忘。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó rén dì yī cì lái Táiwān jiù pèng shàng le dà dìzhèn, ràng tā fēicháng nánwàng.
examples.english: That foreigner encountered a major earthquake on his first visit to Taiwan, which made it very unforgettable for him.

examples.chinese: 我每次寫完考卷都會仔細檢查一遍，要是發現錯誤就馬上改過來。費太太結婚後才發現這是個錯誤決定，她不知道該怎麼辦才好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi cì xiě wán kǎojuàn dōu huì zǐxì jiǎnchá yí biàn, yàoshi fāxiàn cuòwù jiù mǎshàng gǎi guòlái. Fèi tàitai jiéhūn hòu cái fāxiàn zhè shì ge cuòwù juédìng, tā bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn cái hǎo.
examples.english: Every time I finish writing an exam paper, I carefully check it once; if I find a mistake, I immediately correct it. Mrs. Fei only discovered after marriage that this was a wrong decision, and she doesn't know what to do.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 上次我出國旅行時，護照被偷了，幸好導遊通知了當地的外交人員，很快就辦好了新護照。
examples.pinyin: Shàngcì wǒ chūguó lǚxíng shí, hùzhào bèi tōu le, xìngkuī dǎoyóu tōngzhī le dāngdì de wàijiāo rényuán, hěn kuài jiù bàn hǎo le xīn hùzhào.
examples.english: Last time I traveled abroad, my passport was stolen; fortunately, the tour guide notified the local diplomatic personnel, and a new passport was quickly issued.

examples.chinese: 想要讓身體健康，得先注意飲食，少吃太油、太鹹的食物；其次要培養每天運動的好習慣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào ràng shēntǐ jiànkāng, děi xiān zhùyì yǐnshí, shǎo chī tài yóu, tài xián de shíwù; qícì yào péiyǎng měitiān yùndòng de hǎo xíguàn.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, you must first pay attention to your diet and eat less greasy and salty food; secondly, you need to cultivate the good habit of exercising every day.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 天哪！這次期末考真不容易呀，要是考不好被當了，怎麼辦哪？
examples.pinyin: Tiān na! Zhè cì qīmòkǎo zhēn bù róngyì ya, yàoshì kǎo bù hǎo bèi dāng le, zěnme bàn na?
examples.english: Oh my! This final exam is really not easy—if I don't do well and get flunked, what will I do?

examples.chinese: 爸爸挑選西裝時，最重視的是品質，其次才是式樣。
examples.pinyin: Bàba tiāoxuǎn xīzhuāng shí, zuì zhòngshì de shì pǐnzhì, qícì cái shì shìyàng.
examples.english: When Dad chooses a suit, what he values most is quality; style comes second.

examples.chinese: 拿到購物收據，要是發現算錯帳了，就請店員再算一次。
examples.pinyin: Ná dào gòuwù shōujù, yàoshi fāxiàn suàn cuò zhàng le, jiù qǐng diànyuán zài suàn yí cì.
examples.english: When you get the shopping receipt, if you find that the bill has been calculated wrong, ask the clerk to calculate it again.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風可能帶來大量雨水，地形較低的地區應該多注意。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng kěnéng dàilái dàliàng yǔshuǐ, dìxíng jiào dī de dìqū yīnggāi duō zhùyì.
examples.english: This typhoon may bring a great amount of rain, so areas with lower terrain should pay more attention.

examples.chinese: 他每次出國，都會幫朋友代購許多具有當地特色的商品。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi cì chūguó, dōu huì bāng péngyǒu dàigòu xǔduō jùyǒu dāngdì tèsè de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: Every time he goes abroad, he buys on behalf of friends many products with local characteristics.

examples.chinese: A:喲，你今天怎麼穿得這麼帥？ B:下午要參加公司茶會，得穿得正式一些？ A:那下次跟我約會時，也要這麼穿呦！
examples.pinyin: A: Yō, nǐ jīntiān zěnme chuān de zhème shuài? B: Xiàwǔ yào cānjiā gōngsī cháhuì, děi chuān de zhèngshì yīxiē? A: Nà xià cì gēn wǒ yuēhuì shí, yě yào zhème chuān yo!
examples.english: A: Oh! How come you're dressed so handsome today? B: I have to attend the company tea party this afternoon, so I need to dress a bit formally? A: Then next time you go on a date with me, you should dress like this too!

examples.chinese: 這次茶會主要是為了招待客戶，同時透過這個茶會來發表公司的新產品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì cháhuì zhǔyào shì wèile zhāodài kèhù, tóngshí tòuguò zhège cháhuì lái fābiǎo gōngsī de xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This tea party is mainly to entertain clients, and at the same time, through this tea party, to launch the company's new products.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風雨大風又強，大街上不少店家都關店休息。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǔ dà fēng yòu qiáng, dàjiē shang bùshǎo diànjiā dōu guān diàn xiūxi.
examples.english: This typhoon brought heavy rain and strong winds; on the main street, many shops closed to rest.

examples.chinese: 我每個月都會清一次冷氣，這樣比較省電，風也比較涼。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi gè yuè dōu huì qīng yī cì lěngqì, zhèyàng bǐjiào shěng diàn, fēng yě bǐjiào liáng.
examples.english: I clean the air conditioner once every month; this way it saves more electricity, and the air is cooler too.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 那位博士在本次會議中所提到的問題，值得我們進一步研究。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi bóshì zài běn cì huìyì zhōng suǒ tí dào de wèntí, zhídé wǒmen jìnyībù yánjiū.
examples.english: The problems that that PhD mentioned in this conference are worth our further study.

examples.chinese: 每次看到有河流經過的都市，就會想起我生長的家鄉。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì kàndào yǒu héliú jīngguò de dūshì, jiù huì xiǎngqǐ wǒ shēngzhǎng de jiāxiāng.
examples.english: Every time I see a city with a river passing through it, I think of the hometown where I grew up.

examples.chinese: 那件事我已經跟你重複說過好多次了，你怎麼還問我？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiàn shì wǒ yǐjīng gēn nǐ chóngfù shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme hái wèn wǒ?
examples.english: I have already said that matter to you repeatedly many times; how come you are still asking me?

examples.chinese: 每次比賽到了緊張的時候，觀眾就大聲叫喊，我也跟著喊。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì bǐsài dào le jǐnzhāng de shíhòu, guānzhòng jiù dàshēng jiàohǎn, wǒ yě gēnzhe hǎn.
examples.english: Every time the game reaches a tense moment, the audience shouts loudly, and I shout along too.

examples.chinese: 每次到了特別的節日，張先生就會送鮮花給太太，真是浪漫。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dào le tèbié de jiérì, Zhāng xiānsheng jiù huì sòng xiānhuā gěi tàitai, zhēn shì làngmàn.
examples.english: Every time a special holiday comes, Mr. Zhang sends fresh flowers to his wife; it's truly romantic.

examples.chinese: 每次當我回憶起大學的社團生活，就會想到那一群知心好友。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒ huíyì qǐ dàxué de shètuán shēnghuó, jiù huì xiǎngdào nà yī qún zhīxīn hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Every time I recall my university club life, I think of that group of close friends.

examples.chinese: 有位功夫明星的動作很快，一次能踢十幾腿，真的讓人驚訝。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu wèi gōngfu míngxīng de dòngzuò hěn kuài, yī cì néng tī shí jǐ tuǐ, zhēn de ràng rén jīngyà.
examples.english: A certain kung fu star's moves are very fast; he can kick more than ten times in one go—it really surprises people.

examples.chinese: 這所學校規定學生每兩週至少參加一次服務學習活動。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng měi liǎng zhōu zhìshǎo cānjiā yí cì fúwù xuéxí huódòng.
examples.english: This school requires students to participate in at least one service-learning activity every two weeks.

examples.chinese: 上次你跟我提的事，我一點兒印象都沒有，真是不好意思。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì nǐ gēn wǒ tí de shì, wǒ yìdiǎnr yìnxiàng dōu méiyǒu, zhēn shì bù hǎoyìsi.
examples.english: The matter you mentioned to me last time—I don't have the slightest impression of it; I'm really sorry.

examples.chinese: 老師不滿意我們這一組的報告，要我們重做一次。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bù mǎnyì wǒmen zhè yì zǔ de bàogào, yào wǒmen chóng zuò yí cì.
examples.english: The teacher is not satisfied with our group's report and wants us to do it again.

examples.chinese: 這次長途旅行不僅行程豐富，並且讓我交到了不少朋友、擴大了視野。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chángtú lǚxíng bùjǐn xíngchéng fēngfù, bìngqiě ràng wǒ jiāo dào le bùshǎo péngyou, kuòdà le shìyě.
examples.english: This long-distance trip not only had a rich itinerary, but also let me make quite a few friends and broadened my horizons.

examples.chinese: 我的同事遲到的次數太多了，這個月被扣了半個月的薪水。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de tóngshì chídào de cìshù tài duō le, zhè ge yuè bèi kòu le bàn ge yuè de xīnshuǐ.
examples.english: My colleague has been late too many times; this month half a month's salary was deducted.

examples.chinese: 每次我受不了工作壓力時，就會到湖邊散步，看到平靜的湖水，心裡就會平靜下來。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì wǒ shòubuliǎo gōngzuò yālì shí, jiù huì dào húbiān sànbù, kàndào píngjìng de húshuǐ, xīnlǐ jiù huì píngjìng xiàlái.
examples.english: Every time I can't stand the work pressure, I go for a walk by the lake; seeing the tranquil lake water, my heart becomes peaceful.

examples.chinese: 每次有人拜託他幫忙，他都沒拒絕過，因此大家都說他是「好好先生」(yes-man)。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì yǒu rén bàituō tā bāngmáng, tā dōu méi jùjué guò, yīncǐ dàjiā dōu shuō tā shì “hǎohǎo xiānshēng”.
examples.english: Every time someone asks him for help, he has never refused, so everyone calls him a "yes-man."

examples.chinese: 每次當我們在學習華語上遇到困難，老師總是耐心地教導大家。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒmen zài xuéxí Huáyǔ shàng yùdào kùnnán, lǎoshī zǒngshì nàixīn de jiàodǎo dàjiā.
examples.english: Every time we encounter difficulties in learning Chinese, the teacher always patiently teaches everyone.

examples.chinese: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòtánhuì yāoqǐng le gè lǐngyù de rénmen, zhǔyào mùdì shì duì guónèi de dìfāng jiànshè tí yìxiē jiànyì.
examples.english: This forum invited people from various fields; its main purpose is to offer some suggestions for domestic local construction.

examples.chinese: 經過那次任務教訓後，小周做事就變得更加小心了。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò nà cì rènwu jiàoxùn hòu, Xiǎo Zhōu zuòshì jiù biàn de gèngjiā xiǎoxīn le.
examples.english: After the lesson from that mission, Xiao Zhou became even more careful in doing things.

examples.chinese: 他第一次嘗試滑雪，跌了好幾次，好不容易才學會。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì chángshì huáxuě, diē le hǎo jǐ cì, hǎobùróngyì cái xuéhuì.
examples.english: He tried skiing for the first time, fell several times, and only managed to learn it with great difficulty.

examples.chinese: 這次傳染病的病毒很厲害，出門得戴著口罩，免得被傳染。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chuánrǎnbìng de bìngdú hěn lìhài, chūmén děi dàizhe kǒuzhào, miǎnde bèi chuánrǎn.
examples.english: The virus of this infectious disease is very severe; when going out, you must wear a mask so as not to get infected.

examples.chinese: 每次到了新年，華人就會在門前放鞭炮，好好地熱鬧一番。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dào le xīnnián, Huárén jiù huì zài mén qián fàng biānpào, hǎohǎo de rènào yī fān.
examples.english: Every time the New Year arrives, Chinese people set off firecrackers in front of their doors and have a good lively time.

examples.chinese: 他贏了這次選舉只是運氣好罷了，其實他沒什麼能力。
examples.pinyin: Tā yíng le zhè cì xuǎnjǔ zhǐshì yùnqi hǎo bàle, qíshí tā méi shénme nénglì.
examples.english: He won this election only because he was lucky, that's all; actually, he doesn't have much ability.

examples.chinese: 這次活動大家都化裝參加，要是你碰見我大概認不出我是誰。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng dàjiā dōu huàzhuāng cānjiā, yàoshi nǐ pèngjiàn wǒ dàgài rèn bù chū wǒ shì shéi.
examples.english: Everyone is attending this event in disguise; if you run into me, you probably won't recognize who I am.

examples.chinese: 我的親戚是數學教授，每次我有這方面的問題就向他請教。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qīnqi shì shùxué jiàoshòu, měi cì wǒ yǒu zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí jiù xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
examples.english: My relative is a math professor; every time I have a question in this area, I consult him.

examples.chinese: 這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yóuchāi de shēngyīn hěn dà, měi cì tā lái sòng xìn, zhěng tiáo jiē quán dōu tīngjiàn le.
examples.english: This postman's voice is very loud; every time he comes to deliver mail, the whole street hears it.

examples.chinese: 這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bìyè diǎnlǐ, xuéxiào dǎsuàn cǎiyòng kōngpāi de fāngshì lái pāi jìniàn yǐngpiàn.
examples.english: For this graduation ceremony, the school plans to use aerial photography to shoot a commemorative video.

examples.chinese: 經過這次手術，得了重病的嬰兒終於順利地保住了生命。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè cì shǒushù, dé le zhòngbìng de yīng'ér zhōngyú shùnlì de bǎo zhù le shēngmìng.
examples.english: After this surgery, the seriously ill baby finally had its life successfully protected.

examples.chinese: 這個字不好念，我重複了好幾次，同學都說不對，害我好想放棄。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zì bù hǎo niàn, wǒ chóngfù le hǎo jǐ cì, tóngxué dōu shuō bù duì, hài wǒ hǎo xiǎng fàngqì.
examples.english: This character is hard to pronounce; I repeated it several times, and my classmates all said it was wrong, which made me really want to give up.

examples.chinese: 在歷史上，每次革命都對社會造成非常大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Zài lìshǐ shàng, měi cì gémìng dōu duì shèhuì zàochéng fēicháng dà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In history, every revolution has had a very great impact on society.

examples.chinese: 那位模特兒曾多次參與連續劇演出，相當受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mótèér céng duō cì cānyù liánxùjù yǎnchū, xiāngdāng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: That model has participated in TV drama performances many times and is quite popular.

examples.chinese: 不知道是什麼緣故，每次當我見到你時，總是覺得很歡喜。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhīdào shì shénme yuángù, měi cì dāng wǒ jiàn dào nǐ shí, zǒngshì juéde hěn huānxǐ.
examples.english: I don't know what the reason is, but every time I see you, I always feel very happy.

examples.chinese: 小寒特別喜愛射氣球遊戲，每次去逛夜市時總要完五、六回。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎohán tèbié xǐ'ài shè qìqiú yóuxì, měi cì qù guàng yèshì shí zǒng yào wán wǔ, liù huí.
examples.english: Xiaohan especially loves shooting balloon games; every time he goes to the night market, he always plays five or six rounds.

examples.chinese: 這次申請獎學金，達到標準的學生總共不超過十人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shēnqǐng jiǎngxuéjīn, dádào biāozhǔn de xuéshēng zǒnggòng bù chāoguò shí rén.
examples.english: For this scholarship application, the students who meet the standard total no more than ten people.

examples.chinese: 我們公司在這次電子展共發表了九項新產品，並吸引不少國外客戶來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zài zhè cì diànzǐ zhǎn gòng fābiǎo le jiǔ xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn, bìng xīyǐn bù shǎo guówài kèhù lái cānguān.
examples.english: Our company altogether launched nine new products at this electronics exhibition, and attracted many foreign clients to visit.

examples.chinese: 這次的說話比賽要求參加的學生說一個神奇的外國故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuōhuà bǐsài yāoqiú cānjiā de xuéshēng shuō yī gè shénqí de wàiguó gùshì.
examples.english: This speech contest requires participating students to tell a magical foreign story.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的效率真差，有人竟然沒看資料就來了，真是誇張。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de xiàolǜ zhēn chà, yǒu rén jìngrán méi kàn zīliào jiù lái le, zhēn shì kuāzhāng.
examples.english: The efficiency of this meeting is really poor; someone surprisingly came without even looking at the materials—that's really outrageous.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳我去過一次，對他們的菜很失望，從此就不去了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng wǒ qù guò yī cì, duì tāmen de cài hěn shīwàng, cóngcǐ jiù bù qù le.
examples.english: I have been to this restaurant once and was very disappointed with their food, so since then I have not gone back.

examples.chinese: 這次文學比賽，我參加的項目是作文。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì wénxué bǐsài, wǒ cānjiā de xiàngmù shì zuòwén.
examples.english: In this literature competition, the event I am participating in is essay writing.

examples.chinese: 經過多次訓練，他總算贏得這場球賽的冠軍。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò duō cì xùnliàn, tā zǒngsuàn yíngdé zhè chǎng qiúsài de guànjūn.
examples.english: After many training sessions, he finally won the championship of this ball game.

examples.chinese: 這次活動是公司主辦的，目的是為了增加同事之間的感情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng shì gōngsī zhǔbàn de, mùdì shì wèile zēngjiā tóngshì zhījiān de gǎnqíng.
examples.english: This event is organized by the company, and the purpose is to increase the bonds among colleagues.

items.wordHook: With 二(two) breaths and 欠(lack) of rest, she tries again → 次(time).

examples.chinese: 你知道他要結婚的消息了嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào tā yào jiéhūn de xiāoxi le ma?
examples.english: Did you know the news that he is getting married?

examples.chinese: 那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào. Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english: That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me. I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō. Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english: Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast. There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: A:你說老闆下個月要提高每個人的薪水，沒騙我吧？ B:這個消息是從他的口中說出來的，當然是真的。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ shuō lǎobǎn xià gè yuè yào tígāo měi gè rén de xīnshuǐ, méi piàn wǒ ba? B: Zhège xiāoxi shì cóng tā de kǒu zhōng shuō chūlái de, dāngrán shì zhēn de.
examples.english: A: You said the boss is going to raise everyone's salary next month—you're not fooling me, are you? B: This news came out of his own mouth; of course it's true.

examples.chinese: 聽見他欣賞的那位歌星來演唱的消息，令他興奮地跳了起來。
examples.pinyin: Tīngjiàn tā xīnshǎng de nà wèi gēxīng lái yǎnchàng de xiāoxi, lìng tā xīngfèn de tiào le qǐlái.
examples.english: Hearing the news that the singer he admires was coming to sing, he jumped up with excitement.

examples.chinese: 當我聽到被公司錄取的消息時，還以為是做夢，忍不住用力捏了自己一下。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ tīngdào bèi gōngsī lùqǔ de xiāoxi shí, hái yǐwéi shì zuòmèng, rěnbuzhù yònglì niēle zìjǐ yīxià.
examples.english: When I heard the news that I was hired by the company, I still thought I was dreaming, and I couldn't help but pinch myself hard.

examples.chinese: 從事電視新聞工作的人有義務傳播正確的消息。
examples.pinyin: Cóngshì diànshì xīnwén gōngzuò de rén yǒu yìwù chuánbō zhèngquè de xiāoxi.
examples.english: People working in television news have an obligation to disseminate correct information.

examples.chinese: 我舅舅在公司的表現樣樣都好，所以老闆打算明年讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu zài gōngsī de biǎoxiàn yàngyàng dōu hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn dǎsuàn míngnián ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: My uncle's performance at the company is good in every aspect, so the boss plans to make him manager next year.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩在這場大地震中失去了親人，實在太可憐了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái zài zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn zhōng shīqù le qīnrén, shízài tài kělián le.
examples.english: That child lost his family in this big earthquake; it's really too pitiful.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō. Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english: Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast. There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 何小姐習慣去傳統市場買水果，而且都跟同一個攤販買。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě xíguàn qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ, érqiě dōu gēn tóng yí ge tānfàn mǎi.
examples.english: Miss He is used to buying fruit at the traditional market, and she always buys from the same street vendor.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese: 這個週末有一場演唱會，你要不要跟我一起去看？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò yǒu yī chǎng yǎnchànghuì, nǐ yào bu yào gēn wǒ yīqǐ qù kàn?
examples.english: This weekend there is a concert, do you want to go watch it with me?

examples.chinese: 媽媽告訴我，不要忘記去超級市場買飲料。
examples.pinyin: Māma gàosu wǒ, bùyào wàngjì qù chāojí shìchǎng mǎi yǐnliào.
examples.english: Mom told me not to forget to go to the supermarket to buy drinks.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽的花店在百貨公司和超級市場中間。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma de huādiàn zài bǎihuò gōngsī hé chāojí shìchǎng zhōngjiān.
examples.english: My mother's flower shop is between the department store and the supermarket.

examples.chinese: 我明天早上九點要到機場。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn yào dào jīchǎng.
examples.english: I need to arrive at the airport at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 我要到超級市場去買蛋。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào dào chāojí shìchǎng qù mǎi dàn.
examples.english: I want to go to the supermarket to buy eggs.

examples.chinese: 從我家到機場也不遠，開車去、坐捷運去都可以。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào jīchǎng yě bù yuǎn, kāichē qù, zuò jiéyùn qù dōu kěyǐ.
examples.english: It is not far from my house to the airport. I can go by car or MRT.

examples.chinese: 機場附近的風景也很漂亮，我常常去看風景、看飛機。
examples.pinyin: Jīchǎng fùjìn de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliang, wǒ chángcháng qù kàn fēngjǐng, kàn fēijī.
examples.english: The scenery near the airport is beautiful; I often go there to see the view and watch the planes.

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 市場為了改善兒童和青少年的生活品質，而增加了球場、游泳池等休閒場所。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng wèile gǎishàn értóng hé qīngshàonián de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, ér zēngjiā le qiúchǎng, yóuyǒngchí děng xiūxián chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: In order to improve the quality of life for children and teenagers, the market added leisure places such as ball courts and swimming pools.

examples.chinese: 上次出國時，到了機場才發現沒帶護照，這次我絕對不會再忘了。
examples.pinyin: Shàng cì chūguó shí, dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn méi dài hùzhào, zhè cì wǒ juéduì bù huì zài wàng le.
examples.english: Last time I went abroad, I only discovered at the airport that I hadn't brought my passport; this time I absolutely will not forget again.

examples.chinese: 好幾個人都看到他跟這場火災有關，他不但不承認，反而說是鄰居做的。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo jǐ ge rén dōu kàndào tā gēn zhè chǎng huǒzāi yǒuguān, tā búdàn bù chéngrèn, fǎn'ér shuō shì línjū zuò de.
examples.english: Several people saw that he was connected to this fire; not only did he not admit it, but instead he said the neighbor did it.

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 為了符合市場的需求，「快時尚」公司不斷地設計出最流行的服裝樣式。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fúhé shìchǎng de xūqiú, “kuài shíshàng” gōngsī búduàn de shèjì chū zuì liúxíng de fúzhuāng yàngshì.
examples.english: In order to be in accord with market demand, “fast fashion” companies continuously design the most popular clothing styles.

examples.chinese: 這場大地震發生後不久，軍人就立刻趕到了災區，協助救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn fāshēng hòu bùjiǔ, jūnrén jiù lìkè gǎndàole zāiqū, xiézhù jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: Shortly after this major earthquake occurred, soldiers immediately rushed to the disaster area to assist with disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 金先生最近遇到了很不幸的事，他的父母在一場交通意外中去世了。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiānsheng zuìjìn yùdàole hěn búxìng de shì, tā de fùmǔ zài yì chǎng jiāotōng yìwài zhōng qùshì le.
examples.english: Mr. Jin recently encountered a very unfortunate event: his parents died in a traffic accident.

examples.chinese: 在那場車禍中，那個孩子失去了父母，家裡只剩下他一個人，大家都很同情他。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà chǎng chēhuò zhōng, nàge háizi shīqù le fùmǔ, jiālǐ zhǐ shèng xià tā yī ge rén, dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng tā.
examples.english: In that car accident, that child lost his parents, and he was the only one left in the family; everyone sympathized with him.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 易先生從職場退休後，就加入了醫院的服務社團，繼續為社會貢獻一份力量。
examples.pinyin: Yì xiānsheng cóng zhíchǎng tuìxiū hòu, jiù jiārù le yīyuàn de fúwù shètuán, jìxù wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
examples.english: After Mr. Yi retired from the workplace, he joined the hospital's service club and continued to contribute his part to society.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上一醒來就去刷牙、洗臉，然後去附近國小的操場跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang yì xǐnglái jiù qù shuāyá, xǐliǎn, ránhòu qù fùjìn guóxiǎo de cāochǎng pǎobù.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as I wake up, I go brush my teeth and wash my face, and then I go running on the playground of the nearby elementary school.

examples.chinese: 顏小姐的職場表現很優秀，除了外文能力好，做事也很細心。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiǎojiě de zhíchǎng biǎoxiàn hěn yōuxiù, chúle wàiwén nénglì hǎo, zuòshì yě hěn xìxīn.
examples.english: Ms. Yan's performance in the workplace is outstanding; besides having good foreign language skills, she is also very careful in her work.

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 紀先生的部落格擁有不少讀者，下個週末他要辦一場新書活動，買了新書的讀者都可以請他簽名。
examples.pinyin: Jì xiānsheng de bùluògé yōngyǒu bùshǎo dúzhě, xià gè zhōumò tā yào bàn yī chǎng xīnshū huódòng, mǎi le xīnshū de dúzhě dōu kěyǐ qǐng tā qiānmíng.
examples.english: Mr. Ji's blog has quite a few readers; next weekend he will hold a new book event, and readers who have bought the new book can ask him for an autograph.

examples.chinese: 公園附近的停車場還很空，你可以把車停到那裡去。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán fùjìn de tíngchēchǎng hái hěn kōng, nǐ kěyǐ bǎ chē tíng dào nàlǐ qù.
examples.english: The parking lot near the park is still very empty; you can park your car there.

examples.chinese: 學校蓋了一棟活動中心，學生又多了一個交流、休閒的好場所了。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào gài le yī dòng huódòng zhōngxīn, xuéshēng yòu duō le yī gè jiāoliú, xiūxián de hǎo chǎngsuǒ le.
examples.english: The school has built an activity center; the students now have one more good place for interaction and leisure.

examples.chinese: 一大早就有不少民眾在寺廟前的廣場上運動。
examples.pinyin: Yī dàzǎo jiù yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng zài sìmiào qián de guǎngchǎng shàng yùndòng.
examples.english: Early in the morning, quite a few people are already exercising in the square in front of the temple.

examples.chinese: 那棟公寓自從三年前的一場大火之後，就不適合居住了。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng gōngyù zìcóng sān nián qián de yī chǎng dàhuǒ zhīhòu, jiù bù shìhé jūzhù le.
examples.english: Since a big fire three years ago, that apartment building has not been suitable for residing in.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 這座地下停車場因為缺乏經費，沒辦法改善又暗又溼的情形。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dìxià tíngchēchǎng yīnwèi quēfá jīngfèi, méi bànfǎ gǎishàn yòu àn yòu shī de qíngxíng.
examples.english: Because this underground parking lot lacks funds, there is no way to improve its dark and damp condition.

examples.chinese: 因為強烈颱風的關係，機場已經關了，等風小一點才會再開放。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi qiángliè táifēng de guānxì, jīchǎng yǐjīng guān le, děng fēng xiǎo yīdiǎn cái huì zài kāifàng.
examples.english: Because of the strong typhoon, the airport has already closed; it will open again only after the wind gets a little weaker.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

items.wordHook: an 土(earth) field opens under 昜(bright) lights → one grand 場(measure word for concerts).

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 臺灣護照比以前好用得多，去許多國家旅行都不需要簽證了。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hùzhào bǐ yǐqián hǎoyòng de duō, qù xǔduō guójiā lǚxíng dōu bù xūyào qiānzhèng le.
examples.english: A Taiwan passport is much more useful than before; when traveling to many countries, you don't need a visa anymore.

examples.chinese: 小張對世界地理和歷史相當有興趣，為了打開視野，他決定花一年的時間出國旅行。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng duì shìjiè dìlǐ hé lìshǐ xiāngdāng yǒu xìngqù, wèile dǎkāi shìyě, tā juédìng huā yì nián de shíjiān chūguó lǚxíng.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang is quite interested in world geography and history. In order to broaden his vision, he decided to spend a year traveling abroad.

examples.chinese: 公司很重視員工的身心健康，每年都安排一連五天的環島旅行，家人也可以參加。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī hěn zhòngshì yuángōng de shēnxīn jiànkāng, měi nián dōu ānpái yīlián wǔ tiān de huándǎo lǚxíng, jiārén yě kěyǐ cānjiā.
examples.english: The company places great importance on the physical and mental health of its employees, and every year arranges a five-day island tour, which family members can also join.

examples.chinese: 我一直想到歐洲去旅行，只是現在忙得沒時間去，希望明年能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng dào Ōuzhōu qù lǚxíng, zhǐshì xiànzài máng de méi shíjiān qù, xīwàng míngnián néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: I have always wanted to travel to Europe, but I am so busy now that I have no time to go. I hope my dream can come true next year.

examples.chinese: 我不曾一個人去旅行，總是參加團體旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù céng yí ge rén qù lǚxíng, zǒngshì cānjiā tuántǐ lǚyóu.
examples.english: I have never traveled alone; I always join group tours.

examples.chinese: 我去義大利旅行的時候，不小心把護照弄丟了，我擔心死了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yìdàlì lǚxíng de shíhou, bù xiǎoxīn bǎ hùzhào nòngdiū le, wǒ dānxīn sǐ le.
examples.english: When I was traveling in Italy, I accidentally lost my passport; I was worried to death.

examples.chinese: 我想趁著暑假去旅行，你有什麼建議嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng chènzhe shǔjià qù lǚxíng, nǐ yǒu shénme jiànyì ma?
examples.english: I want to take advantage of the summer vacation to travel; do you have any suggestions?

examples.chinese: 我買了幾張當地的明信片，這些是這次旅行很好的紀念。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ zhāng dāngdì de míngxìnpiàn, zhèxiē shì zhè cì lǚxíng hěn hǎo de jìniàn.
examples.english: I bought several local postcards; these are a very good souvenir of this trip.

examples.chinese: 沒想到利用春假出國旅行的人真不少！
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào lìyòng chūnjià chūguó lǚxíng de rén zhēn bùshǎo!
examples.english: I didn't expect that there are really quite a few people who take advantage of spring break to travel abroad!

examples.chinese: 旅行的目的除了看風景，還可以了解那個地方的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíng de mùdì chúle kàn fēngjǐng, hái kěyǐ liǎojiě nàge dìfāng de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The purpose of travel, besides seeing the scenery, is also to understand the cultural features of that place.

examples.chinese: 很多大學生利用暑假去國外旅行或是學語言。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dàxuéshēng lìyòng shǔjià qù guówài lǚxíng huòshì xué yǔyán.
examples.english: Many college students use summer vacation to travel abroad or learn languages.

examples.chinese: 這次的旅行很順利，沒有什麼問題。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lǚxíng hěn shùnlì, méiyǒu shénme wèntí.
examples.english: This trip was very smooth; there were no problems.

examples.chinese: 下課以後，我要跟同學討論去日月潭旅行的事情。
examples.pinyin: Xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ yào gēn tóngxué tǎolùn qù Rìyuètán lǚxíng de shìqing.
examples.english: After class, I want to discuss the trip to Sun Moon Lake with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 這次去荷蘭旅行的費用很高，因為車票很貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qù Hélán lǚxíng de fèiyòng hěn gāo, yīnwèi chēpiào hěn guì.
examples.english: The cost of this trip to the Netherlands is very high because the train tickets are very expensive.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡去旅行，因為可以認識很多有趣的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān qù lǚxíng, yīnwèi kěyǐ rènshi hěn duō yǒuqù de rén.
examples.english: I like to travel because I can meet many interesting people.

examples.chinese: 阿里山擁有豐富的森林資源和獨特的自然風景，每年都吸引不少遊客去那裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Ālǐshān yǒngyǒu fēngfù de sēnlín zīyuán hé dútè de zìrán fēngjǐng, měi nián dōu xīyǐn bùshǎo yóukè qù nàlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: Alishan owns rich forest resources and unique natural scenery, attracting many tourists to travel there every year.

examples.chinese: 這座島的風景很美，旅館價格也很合理，難怪不少遊客年年都來這裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dǎo de fēngjǐng hěn měi, lǚguǎn jiàgé yě hěn hélǐ, nánguài bùshǎo yóukè niánnián dōu lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: The scenery of this island is beautiful, and the hotel prices are also reasonable; no wonder many tourists come here to travel year after year.

examples.chinese: 上次我出國旅行時，護照被偷了，幸好導遊通知了當地的外交人員，很快就辦好了新護照。
examples.pinyin: Shàngcì wǒ chūguó lǚxíng shí, hùzhào bèi tōu le, xìngkuī dǎoyóu tōngzhī le dāngdì de wàijiāo rényuán, hěn kuài jiù bàn hǎo le xīn hùzhào.
examples.english: Last time I traveled abroad, my passport was stolen; fortunately, the tour guide notified the local diplomatic personnel, and a new passport was quickly issued.

examples.chinese: 叔叔時常跟我聊他到世界各地旅行的故事，真是有意思。
examples.pinyin: Shūshu shícháng gēn wǒ liáo tā dào shìjiè gèdì lǚxíng de gùshì, zhēn shì yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle often chats with me about his stories of traveling around the world; it's really interesting.

examples.chinese: 我心中有兩個夢想，一是當歌星，另一個是去各國旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīn zhōng yǒu liǎng ge mèngxiǎng, yī shì dāng gēxīng, lìng yí ge shì qù gè guó lǚxíng.
examples.english: I have two dreams in my heart: one is to become a singer, and the other is to travel to various countries.

examples.chinese: 如果你想到菲律賓旅行，還是帶著美金到當地換錢比較方便。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ xiǎng dào Fēilǜbīn lǚxíng, háishì dàizhe měijīn dào dāngdì huànqián bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
examples.english: If you want to travel to the Philippines, it's more convenient to bring US dollars and exchange money locally.

examples.chinese: 國外旅行時隨時攜帶護照、信用卡，可讓你玩得安心又順利。
examples.pinyin: Guówài lǚxíng shí suíshí xiédài hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, kě ràng nǐ wán de ānxīn yòu shùnlì.
examples.english: When traveling abroad, carrying your passport and credit card at all times can let you have fun with peace of mind and smoothly.

examples.chinese: 不少人利用新年期間到國外旅行，國內過年的氣氛就越來越淡了。
examples.pinyin: Bù shǎo rén lìyòng xīnnián qījiān dào guówài lǚxíng, guónèi guònián de qìfēn jiù yuèláiyuè dàn le.
examples.english: Many people take advantage of the New Year period to travel abroad, so the atmosphere of celebrating the New Year domestically is becoming weaker and weaker.

examples.chinese: 上個星期我去鄉下旅行，當地人非常好客。
examples.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqī wǒ qù xiāngxià lǚxíng, dāngdìrén fēicháng hàokè.
examples.english: Last week I traveled to the countryside; the local people were very hospitable.

examples.chinese: 一個國家光是依靠免費簽證，是無法吸引國外遊客來旅行的。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè guójiā guāng shì yīkào miǎnfèi qiānzhèng, shì wúfǎ xīyǐn guówài yóukè lái lǚxíng de.
examples.english: A country solely relying on free visas is unable to attract foreign tourists to travel.

examples.chinese: 參加旅行團或自助旅遊各有各的優點，懶得自己安排行程的人，就跟著導遊走吧。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lǚxíngtuán huò zìzhù lǚyóu gè yǒu gè de yōudiǎn, lǎn de zìjǐ ānpái xíngchéng de rén, jiù gēnzhe dǎoyóu zǒu ba.
examples.english: Joining a tour group or traveling independently each has its own advantages; those who are too lazy to arrange their own itinerary should just follow the tour guide.

examples.chinese: 我們工廠與那家旅行社有合作關係，廠內員工如果報名他們的旅行團，都可以享受優惠價。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngchǎng yǔ nà jiā lǚxíngshè yǒu hézuò guānxì, chǎng nèi yuángōng rúguǒ bàomíng tāmen de lǚxíngtuán, dōu kěyǐ xiǎngshòu yōuhuì jià.
examples.english: Our factory has a partnership with that travel agency; if employees sign up for their tour group, they can all enjoy a discounted price.

examples.chinese: 旅行團的行程及路線是公司及導遊決定的，不喜歡的話，就只能自助旅遊了。
examples.pinyin: Lǚxíngtuán de xíngchéng jí lùxiàn shì gōngsī jí dǎoyóu juédìng de, bù xǐhuān de huà, jiù zhǐ néng zìzhù lǚyóu le.
examples.english: The itinerary and route of a tour group are decided by the company and the tour guide; if you don't like it, then you can only travel independently.

examples.chinese: 這個旅行團的目的地是中國北京(Beijing)，旅客目的是參觀古蹟及拜訪朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǚxíngtuán de mùdìdì shì Zhōngguó Běijīng, lǚkè mùdì shì cānguān gǔjì jí bàifǎng péngyǒu.
examples.english: The destination of this tour group is Beijing, China; the travelers' purpose is to visit historical sites and visit friends.

examples.chinese: 我去英國留學時，常利用週末到旅行社打工，帶觀光客到著名的景點觀光。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Yīngguó liúxué shí, cháng lìyòng zhōumò dào lǚxíngshè dǎgōng, dài guānguāngkè dào zhùmíng de jǐngdiǎn guānguāng.
examples.english: When I studied abroad in the UK, I often used weekends to work part-time at a travel agency, taking tourists sightseeing to famous attractions.

examples.chinese: 學校每學期都帶學生到郊外旅行，體驗大自然的美好。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào měi xuéqī dōu dài xuéshēng dào jiāowài lǚxíng, tǐyàn dàzìrán de měihǎo.
examples.english: Every semester, the school takes students on trips to the outskirts to experience the beauty of nature.

examples.chinese: 我夢想有一天可以到世界各地旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèngxiǎng yǒu yìtiān kěyǐ dào shìjiè gèdì lǚxíng.
examples.english: I dream of one day being able to travel to all parts of the world.

examples.chinese: 我請旅行社代訂從台北直飛美國的班機，機票較貴，但能節省不少時間。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qǐng lǚxíngshè dài dìng cóng Táiběi zhífēi Měiguó de bānjī, jīpiào jiào guì, dàn néng jiéshěng bùshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: I asked the travel agency to book a flight from Taipei directly to the US; the ticket is more expensive, but it can save quite a bit of time.

examples.chinese: 我去澳洲登山時，碰見了正在自助旅行的老朋友，真巧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Àozhōu dēngshān shí, pèngjiàn le zhèngzài zìzhù lǚxíng de lǎo péngyou, zhēn qiǎo!
examples.english: When I went mountain climbing in Australia, I ran into an old friend who was traveling independently—what a coincidence!

examples.chinese: 這次長途旅行不僅行程豐富，並且讓我交到了不少朋友、擴大了視野。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chángtú lǚxíng bùjǐn xíngchéng fēngfù, bìngqiě ràng wǒ jiāo dào le bùshǎo péngyou, kuòdà le shìyě.
examples.english: This long-distance trip not only had a rich itinerary, but also let me make quite a few friends and broadened my horizons.

examples.chinese: 每年安排一段時間去旅行，說不定能帶給你更豐富的生活。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián ānpái yī duàn shíjiān qù lǚxíng, shuōbudìng néng dài gěi nǐ gèng fēngfù de shēnghuó.
examples.english: If you arrange a period of time to travel every year, it might bring you a richer life.

examples.chinese: 自從去年伯母退休後，就帶著伯父到處去旅行了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng qùnián bómǔ tuìxiū hòu, jiù dàizhe bófù dàochù qù lǚxíng le.
examples.english: Ever since my aunt retired last year, she has been taking my uncle traveling everywhere.

examples.chinese: 去旅行的話，我有法子讓你用最少的預算擁有最豐富的行程。
examples.pinyin: Qù lǚxíng de huà, wǒ yǒu fǎzi ràng nǐ yòng zuì shǎo de yùsuàn yǒngyǒu zuì fēngfù de xíngchéng.
examples.english: If you go traveling, I have a way to let you have the richest itinerary with the smallest budget.

examples.chinese: 他在國外旅行時因為簽證有問題，回國時間只好提前了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài guówài lǚxíng shí yīnwèi qiānzhèng yǒu wèntí, huíguó shíjiān zhǐhǎo tíqián le.
examples.english: While traveling abroad, because there was a problem with his visa, his return date had to be moved up.

examples.chinese: 對他來說，這趟旅行的唯一目的僅是為了尋找畫畫的題材。
examples.pinyin: Duì tā lái shuō, zhè tàng lǚxíng de wéiyī mùdì jǐn shì wèile xúnzhǎo huà huà de tícái.
examples.english: For him, the only purpose of this trip is solely to find subjects for painting.

examples.chinese: 千萬別帶著笨重的行李去旅行，那會給你帶來很多麻煩。
examples.pinyin: Qiānwàn bié dài zhe bènzhòng de xíngli qù lǚxíng, nà huì gěi nǐ dàilái hěnduō máfan.
examples.english: By all means don't travel with heavy, cumbersome luggage; that will bring you a lot of trouble.

examples.chinese: 這家旅行社有宣傳活動，所以裡頭、外頭都站滿了人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā lǚxíngshè yǒu xuānchuán huódòng, suǒyǐ lǐtou, wàitou dōu zhàn mǎn le rén.
examples.english: This travel agency has a promotional event, so both inside and outside are full of people.

examples.chinese: 在人生地不熟的地方旅行時，如有當地人帶路，就可以節省不少時間。
examples.pinyin: Zài rénshēngdìbùshú de dìfāng lǚxíng shí, rú yǒu dāngdìrén dàilù, jiù kěyǐ jiéshěng bùshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: When traveling in a place where you are unfamiliar with the people and surroundings, if a local leads the way, you can save quite a bit of time.

examples.chinese: 難得出國旅行，一定要多照幾張相片留念。
examples.pinyin: Nándé chūguó lǚxíng, yīdìng yào duō zhào jǐ zhāng xiàngpiàn liúniàn.
examples.english: It is rare to travel abroad, so you must take a few more photos to keep as souvenirs.

examples.chinese: 我旅行的方式很隨意，出發前從不先規劃行程。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ lǚxíng de fāngshì hěn suíyì, chūfā qián cóng bù xiān guīhuà xíngchéng.
examples.english: My way of traveling is very much as I wish; before setting out, I never plan the itinerary in advance.

examples.chinese: 有時改變原來旅行的安排，可能會帶來不同的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushí gǎibiàn yuánlái lǚxíng de ānpái, kěnéng huì dàilái bùtóng de lèqù.
examples.english: Sometimes changing the original travel arrangements may bring different pleasures.

examples.chinese: 要前往國外旅行，得先確認當地現在的氣候，好收拾行李。
examples.pinyin: Yào qiánwǎng guówài lǚxíng, děi xiān quèrèn dāngdì xiànzài de qìhòu, hǎo shōushí xínglǐ.
examples.english: To go abroad for travel, you must first confirm the local current climate so as to pack your luggage.

examples.chinese: 出國旅行最好辦個保險，發生意外時才能獲得保障。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó lǚxíng zuìhǎo bàn ge bǎoxiǎn, fāshēng yìwài shí cái néng huòdé bǎozhàng.
examples.english: When traveling abroad, it is best to get insurance; only then can you obtain protection when an accident occurs.

items.wordHook: 旅(journey) + 行(go) → to go on a journey, to travel.

examples.chinese: 天上有無數個星星，聚在一起就變成了美麗的銀河。
examples.pinyin: Tiānshàng yǒu wúshù ge xīngxing, jù zài yìqǐ jiù biànchéng le měilì de yínhé.
examples.english: There are countless stars in the sky; gathering together, they become the beautiful Milky Way.

examples.chinese: 哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
examples.english: My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family.

examples.chinese: 奶奶養了幾隻雞，每天早上習慣抓兩把玉米餵牠們。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai yǎngle jǐ zhī jī, měitiān zǎoshang xíguàn zhuā liǎng bǎ yùmǐ wèi tāmen.
examples.english: Grandma raises several chickens, and every morning she is used to grabbing two handfuls of corn to feed them.

items.wordHook: Combining 玉(jade) and 米(rice): 玉米 means corn.

examples.chinese: 連警察都證明這個車禍是段老闆喝醉造成的，可是他仍然不肯承認。
examples.pinyin: Lián jǐngchá dōu zhèngmíng zhège chēhuò shì Duàn lǎobǎn hē zuì zàochéng de, kěshì tā réngrán bù kěn chéngrèn.
examples.english: Even the police proved that this car accident was caused by Boss Duan getting drunk, but he still refuses to admit it.

examples.chinese: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

examples.chinese: 心裡很平靜(peaceful)的人，就算居住在人車又多又吵的市區，仍然覺得自在。
examples.pinyin: Xīnlǐ hěn píngjìng de rén, jiùsuàn jūzhù zài rén chē yòu duō yòu chǎo de shìqū, réngrán juéde zìzài.
examples.english: People who are very peaceful inside, even if they live in an urban district with many people and cars and lots of noise, still feel at ease.

examples.chinese: 儘管他沒主持過什麼節目，他的獨特風格仍然引起大家注意。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā méi zhǔchí guò shénme jiémù, tā de dútè fēnggé réngrán yǐnqǐ dàjiā zhùyì.
examples.english: Although he has never hosted any programs, his unique style still attracted everyone's attention.

examples.chinese: 工會代表跟老闆討論工資問題，認為公司給的工錢仍然太低。
examples.pinyin: Gōnghuì dàibiǎo gēn lǎobǎn tǎolùn gōngzī wèntí, rènwéi gōngsī gěi de gōngqián réngrán tài dī.
examples.english: The union representative discussed the wage issue with the boss, believing that the wages the company offers are still too low.

examples.chinese: 我吃得少，每天早上也運動，但是我的體重仍然超重。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chī de shǎo, měitiān zǎoshang yě yùndòng, dànshì wǒ de tǐzhòng réngrán chāozhòng.
examples.english: I eat little and also exercise every morning, but my weight is still overweight.

items.wordHook: Combining 仍(yet) and 然(certainly): 仍然 means still, yet.

examples.chinese: 那家超市蔬菜水果的種類很多，可提供民眾較多的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì shūcài shuǐguǒ de zhǒnglèi hěn duō, kě tígōng mínzhòng jiào duō de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: That supermarket has many kinds of vegetables and fruits, which can provide people with more choices.

examples.chinese: 那家文具店賣的文具種類很多，像筆、書包、本子等學生用品，不僅品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā wénjù diàn mài de wénjù zhǒnglèi hěn duō, xiàng bǐ, shūbāo, běnzi děng xuésheng yòngpǐn, bùjǐn pǐnzhì hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
