examples.english: The stationery store sells many kinds of stationery, such as pens, backpacks, notebooks, and other student supplies; not only is the quality good, but the price is also not expensive.

examples.chinese: 在地理條件好的地區，不但農產品種類較多，價格也便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zài dìlǐ tiáojiàn hǎo de dìqū, bùdàn nóngchǎnpǐn zhǒnglèi jiào duō, jiàgé yě piányi.
examples.english: In areas with good geographical conditions, not only are there more types of agricultural produce, but the prices are also cheaper.

examples.chinese: 根據手術的種類，病人在動手術前能吃的食物也不太相同。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù shǒushù de zhǒnglèi, bìngrén zài dòng shǒushù qián néng chī de shíwù yě bù tài xiāngtóng.
examples.english: Depending on the type of surgery, the food patients can eat before undergoing surgery is also not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 這桌喜酒有很多海鮮，但我只能吃魚，其他種類的海鮮都會讓我皮膚紅腫(inflamed)。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhuō xǐjiǔ yǒu hěn duō hǎixiān, dàn wǒ zhǐ néng chī yú, qítā zhǒnglèi de hǎixiān dōu huì ràng wǒ pífū hóngzhǒng.
examples.english: This table of wedding wine has a lot of seafood, but I can only eat fish; other types of seafood all make my skin swell and turn red.

examples.chinese: 奶油不但種類多，並且是做甜點時不能少的材料。
examples.pinyin: Nǎiyóu bùdàn zhǒnglèi duō, bìngqiě shì zuò tiándiǎn shí bùnéng shǎo de cáiliào.
examples.english: Butter not only comes in many types, but is also an indispensable ingredient when making desserts.

examples.chinese: 這對情侶找了幾位朋友商量，一起安排結婚典禮。
examples.pinyin: Zhè duì qínglǚ zhǎo le jǐ wèi péngyou shāngliang, yīqǐ ānpái jiéhūn diǎnlǐ.
examples.english: This couple found several friends to consult with and together arrange their wedding ceremony.

examples.chinese: 無論發生什麼事，她都會跟父母商量，並參考他們的意見。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn fāshēng shénme shì, tā dōu huì gēn fùmǔ shāngliang, bìng cānkǎo tāmen de yìjiàn.
examples.english: No matter what happens, she will discuss it with her parents and refer to their opinions.

examples.chinese: 我們到小張家時，他端了一盤切好的水果來招待我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dào Xiǎo Zhāng jiā shí, tā duān le yī pán qiē hǎo de shuǐguǒ lái zhāodài wǒmen.
examples.english: When we arrived at Little Zhang's house, he brought out a plate of cut fruit to treat us.

examples.chinese: 個性親切、大方，通常是從事服務業的最佳人才。
examples.pinyin: Gèxìng qīnqiè, dàfāng, tōngcháng shì cóngshì fúwùyè de zuìjiā réncái.
examples.english: People with a friendly and generous personality are usually the best talent for working in the service industry.

examples.chinese: 要想成為成功的上班族，一切就得照規矩來。
examples.pinyin: Yào xiǎng chéngwéi chénggōng de shàngbānzú, yīqiè jiù děi zhào guīju lái.
examples.english: If you want to become a successful office worker, everything must be done according to the rules.

examples.chinese: 曾經失去一切的人，更懂得愛惜現在擁有的一切。
examples.pinyin: Céngjīng shīqù yíqiè de rén, gèng dǒngde àixī xiànzài yōngyǒu de yíqiè.
examples.english: People who have once lost everything understand even more how to cherish everything they have now.

examples.chinese: 大自然除了有各種動植物，還有山地、平原、河流等等，這一切應該是上帝創造的。
examples.pinyin: Dàzìrán chúle yǒu gè zhǒng dòngzhíwù, hái yǒu shāndì, píngyuán, héliú děngděng, zhè yíqiè yīnggāi shì Shàngdì chuàngzào de.
examples.english: In addition to having various animals and plants, nature also has mountains, plains, rivers, and so on; all of this was presumably created by God.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳，沒有人替你服務，點菜、拿碗筷等一切都得自助。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng, méiyǒu rén tì nǐ fúwù, diǎncài, ná wǎnkuài děng yīqiè dōu děi zìzhù.
examples.english: In this restaurant, no one serves you; ordering dishes, getting bowls and chopsticks, and everything else must be self-service.

examples.chinese: 以前我的小學老師總是親切地教導我們，讓我到現在還是很懷念她。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ de xiǎoxué lǎoshī zǒngshì qīnqiè de jiàodǎo wǒmen, ràng wǒ dào xiànzài háishì hěn huáiniàn tā.
examples.english: My elementary school teacher used to teach us kindly, which makes me still cherish her memory even now.

examples.chinese: 我習慣來這家銀行存款，因為這裡的員工都十分親切。你在辦一些國家的簽證時，他們得看你的銀行存款。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn lái zhè jiā yínháng cúnkuǎn, yīnwèi zhèlǐ de yuángōng dōu shífēn qīnqiè. Nǐ zài bàn yīxiē guójiā de qiānzhèng shí, tāmen děi kàn nǐ de yínháng cúnkuǎn.
examples.english: I am used to coming to this bank to deposit money, because the employees here are all very friendly. When you apply for visas for some countries, they need to see your bank savings.

examples.chinese: 他說的華語帶點兒家鄉口音，聽起來很親切。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō de Huáyǔ dài diǎnr jiāxiāng kǒuyīn, tīng qǐlái hěn qīnqiè.
examples.english: The Mandarin he speaks carries a bit of a hometown accent, which sounds very warm and friendly.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

examples.chinese: 那個店員經常對客人微笑，讓人覺得很親切。
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán jīngcháng duì kèrén wēixiào, ràng rén juéde hěn qīnqiè.
examples.english: That clerk often smiles at customers, making people feel very friendly.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生對客人很親切，讓客人都吃得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng duì kèrén hěn qīnqiè, ràng kèrén dōu chī de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: The waiters at that restaurant are very kind to the customers, which makes the customers all eat happily.

examples.chinese: 人人都崇拜明星，但有多少人了解成功背後所付出的一切？
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu chóngbài míngxīng, dàn yǒu duōshǎo rén liǎojiě chénggōng bèihòu suǒ fùchū de yíqiè?
examples.english: Everyone adores stars, but how many people understand all that is sacrificed behind success?

items.wordHook: Dividing 七(seven) crisp portions of fruit with a keen 刀(knife) across the kitchen counter → 切(cut).

examples.chinese: 他希望能在海邊舉辦婚禮，可是一直找不到理想的場地。
examples.pinyin: Tā xīwàng néng zài hǎibiān jǔbàn hūnlǐ, kěshì yīzhí zhǎo bù dào lǐxiǎng de chǎngdì.
examples.english: He hopes to hold his wedding by the seaside, but he has not been able to find an ideal venue.

examples.chinese: 台灣這場地震的規模很大，使許多人受輕傷、重傷。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān zhè chǎng dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, shǐ xǔduō rén shòu qīngshāng, zhòngshāng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake in Taiwan was very large, causing many people to suffer minor and serious injuries.

items.wordHook: 再(again) + 見(see) = see you again, which is what 再見 means: good-bye.
a 禾(grain) drops into a 口(mouth) and both chew together → 和(and).
Combining 演(perform) and 戲(play): 演戲 means play in a drama.
Tying each trade with a continuous 糹(silk) cord from one vendor 賣(sell) stall to the next ensures a 續(continuous) supply.
聰(smart) + 明(bright) → smart: sharp ears and bright eyes.
a 言(speech) marks a 志(determination) stone, cut deep → a lasting 誌(determination).
Combining 連(join) and 絡(web): 連絡 means connect.
